failureReason: The model attempted to write code but failed to create correct implementations. In run-1, the model created lib/catalog.ts with TypeScript type errors (status field type mismatch) and app/page.tsx that imported getCatalogProducts instead of directly calling getAllProducts from lib/db as expected by tests. The test "Page fetches products via lib/db" failed because the regex pattern expected direct imports/calls to getAllProducts from lib/db, but the model instead created an intermediary wrapper function.
